title: QCLI-519 follow-up: the CHANGELOG entry calls five failure outcomes three, three ref shapes are untested, and the ref reader and the CLI scanner keep separate record-directory lists
description:
Three NITs from the QCLI-519 round-2 FULL review (unit quest-cli-review-656r2, model deepseek-flash, DEC-183 Stage 1), which APPROVED opum-ai/quest-cli#656 at ceb5beff (merged as 99e8980f). All three are MINOR in effect but none blocks anything shipped; the command is correct as delivered.

(a) CHANGELOG.md:24 says "Three failure outcomes" for task view --ref but then documents five: not_found with input.code task_not_found, not_found with input.code ref_not_resolvable, drift ref_records_unreadable, drift ref_record_duplicate, and conflict task_reference_ambiguous. Count and text must agree.

(b) Three ref shapes have no test: an option-shaped --ref=-x (it must be exit 3 ref_not_resolvable, never an option injection), a lightweight tag, and an abbreviated sha. The review proved the first by hand only, which is exactly the shape a regression would silently reopen.

(c) src/application/tasks/read-at-ref.ts scans CONTINUITY_TASK_LOCATIONS while the CLI scan uses TASK_RECORD_SUBDIRECTORIES (src/cli/main.ts:1393). Two lists that must agree and nothing that makes them: give them one home or a parity test.

Not to be worked until the day plan names it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CHANGELOG entry for task view --ref states the number of failure outcomes it actually documents, and that number matches the five documented (two exit-3 not_found codes, two exit-6 drift codes, one exit-5 conflict)
Tests pin an option-shaped --ref=-x (exit 3, ref_not_resolvable), a lightweight tag, and an abbreviated sha, each asserting the resolved commit sha rather than the object the spelling names
The record-directory list has one home: the ref reader and the CLI scanner share a constant, or a parity test fails when the two lists diverge

plan: 1. Correct the CHANGELOG entry for task view --ref: it says Three failure outcomes and documents five (two exit-3 not_found codes, two exit-6 drift codes, one exit-5 conflict), so the number becomes five.

2. Add three tests to test/qcli519-task-view-at-ref.test.ts: an option-shaped --ref=-x is exit 3 ref_not_resolvable with input.ref -x and never a usage error; a lightweight tag reports the commit sha it points at; an abbreviated sha reports the full resolved commit sha.

3. Give the record-directory list one home: CONTINUITY_TASK_LOCATIONS becomes the domain TASK_LOCATIONS (re-exported to the CLI layer), so the ref reader, continuity, across-refs and the CLI scanner all read the same list.
4. Run bun run check with the pinned bun, commit on fix/QCLI-527-ref-followups, push, open the PR and report its head SHA.
implementationNotes: All three QCLI-519 round-2 NITs addressed. (a) The CHANGELOG entry now says Five failure outcomes, matching the five it documents: not_found/task_not_found, not_found/ref_not_resolvable, drift/ref_records_unreadable, drift/ref_record_duplicate and conflict. (b) Three tests added to test/qcli519-task-view-at-ref.test.ts: an option-shaped --ref=-x is exit 3 not_found with input.code ref_not_resolvable and input.ref -x, never a usage error; a real lightweight tag (no object of its own) reports the commit sha it points at and reads dev T-1 as To Do, proving the resolution; an 8-character abbreviated sha reports the FULL resolved commit sha in the envelope. (c) The record-location list has one home: CONTINUITY_TASK_LOCATIONS is now the domain TASK_LOCATIONS, re-exported through application/tasks/tasks.ts for the CLI layer, so the ref reader, continuity, across-refs and the CLI id scanner all read the same array; the second literal in main.ts is deleted. Verified: bun run check exit 0 under bun 1.4.3 -- typecheck, lint, format, layer, 1304 unit tests, 45 mod tests; the ref test file is 18 pass / 0 fail (15 before, 3 new). Local mod arm reports NOT TYPECHECKED for Claude Code 2.1.308 (no declaration on this machine, pre-existing).
finalSummary: QCLI-527 closes the three QCLI-519 round-2 NITs. The task view --ref CHANGELOG entry now says five failure outcomes, matching the five it documents (two exit-3 not_found codes, two exit-6 drift codes, one exit-5 conflict). Three previously hand-proven ref shapes are pinned by tests: an option-shaped --ref=-x is exit 3 ref_not_resolvable with input.ref -x and never a usage error; a real lightweight tag reports the commit sha it points at; an abbreviated sha reports the full resolved commit sha. The record-location list now has one home -- the domain TASK_LOCATIONS, re-exported to the CLI layer -- so the ref reader, continuity, across-refs and the CLI id scanner cannot diverge. Verified with bun run check exit 0 under bun 1.4.3 (typecheck, lint, format, layer, 1304 unit tests, 45 mod tests; the ref test file is 18 pass; local mod arm NOT TYPECHECKED for 2.1.308, pre-existing).
